sources.scope: Publisher clinical review, not an official ERC or EU guideline. Bounded corroboration that suspected air embolism/haemolysis requires stopping HD without extracorporeal-blood return. No adoption of complete resuscitation algorithm, positioning or generic return-for-bleeding advice.
sources.rights_note: Publisher/author rights retained; no article-specific open reuse licence established in this lane. Public indexed primary passage used as a reference only; no full article, figure or algorithm copied into Git or downloaded by bypass.

No complete correction/retraction search or 2026 resuscitation-guideline clearance claimed.
